source.title: Probability measures on 2 x 2 stochastic matrices: Some open problems

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as the single zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/1124701 with document identifier 1124701. Local workflow shard metadata, OpenAlex metadata, Crossref metadata, and the DOI landing-page search result identify the exact work as 'Probability measures on 2 x 2 stochastic matrices: Some open problems', Nonlinear Analysis: Theory, Methods & Applications 30(8), pages 4899-4902, 1997, DOI 10.1016/S0362-546X(96)00271-4.

Treated zbMATH as a bibliographic resolver rather than a technical source. Direct shell fetches to zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed in this environment with DNS resolution errors. Hosted page/search access did not expose a readable zbMATH record body or a document/full-text link.

Failure mode: metadata_only plus paywalled_or_restricted. The DOI resolves to a ScienceDirect landing page for the exact work, but the available readable content was bibliographic metadata, abstract text, references, and a 'View full text' link rather than the article body or PDF. Exact-work recovery searched the title plus PDF, the DOI plus PDF, the ScienceDirect PII S0362546X96002714, OpenAlex W2048939497, Crossref DOI metadata, and title/author variants. Candidate pages were rejected when they were metadata-only, abstract-only, search snippets, citing papers, related later papers on the same topic, or different works.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source was recovered. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, OpenAlex/Crossref/local shard rows, ScienceDirect abstract text, citation pages, search snippets, or related works.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source artifact.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/1124701.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
